steps.summary:
• Replace static API keys with cryptographically attested, short-lived machine identities using SPIFFE/SPIRE and decentralized credentials tied to runtime environments.
• Enforce dynamic Policy-as-Code and downscoped OAuth token delegation to govern probabilistic agent actions with real-time, context-aware access controls.
• Eliminate static secrets using workload identity federation and implement continuous behavioral monitoring to automatically revoke compromised or drifting agent sessions.
